name: Language
subject: Language
description: Here you will find the expectations and learning for the four areas of study for Grade 5 Language.

strands.title: Literacy Connections and Applications
strands.describer: Throughout Grade 5, in connection with the learning in strands B to D, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Transferable Skills
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 5, in connection with the learning in strands B to D, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of how the seven transferable skills (critical thinking and problem solving; innovation, creativity, and entrepreneurship; self-directed learning; collaboration; communication; global citizenship and sustainability; and digital literacy) are used in various language and literacy contexts
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of how the seven transferable skills (critical thinking and problem solving; innovation, creativity, and entrepreneurship; self-directed learning; collaboration; communication; global citizenship and sustainability; and digital literacy) are used in various language and literacy contexts

specific_expectations.text: explain how transferable skills can be used to support communication in various cultural, social, linguistic, and domain-specific contexts, and apply them when reading, listening to, viewing, and creating texts of various forms
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how transferable skills can be used to support communication in various cultural, social, linguistic, and domain-specific contexts, and apply them when reading, listening to, viewing, and creating texts of various forms

specific_expectations.text: explain how transferable skills help them to express their voice, be engaged in their learning, and plan the next steps to develop their capabilities and potential
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how transferable skills help them to express their voice, be engaged in their learning, and plan the next steps to develop their capabilities and potential

overall_expectations.title: Digital Media Literacy
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 5, in connection with the learning in strands B to D, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate and apply the knowledge and skills needed to interact safely and responsibly in online environments, use digital and media tools to construct knowledge, and demonstrate learning as critical consumers and creators of media
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate and apply the knowledge and skills needed to interact safely and responsibly in online environments, use digital and media tools to construct knowledge, and demonstrate learning as critical consumers and creators of media

specific_expectations.text: explain their rights and responsibilities when interacting online with appropriate permission, and make decisions that contribute positively to the development of their digital identity and those of their communities
specific_expectations.text_html: explain their rights and responsibilities when interacting online with appropriate permission, and make decisions that contribute positively to the development of their digital identity and those of their communities

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of how to navigate online environments safely, manage their privacy and personal data, and interact in a way that supports their well-being and that of others, including seeking appropriate permission
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of how to navigate online environments safely, manage their privacy and personal data, and interact in a way that supports their well-being and that of others, including seeking appropriate permission

specific_expectations.text: gather, evaluate, and use information, considering validity, credibility, accuracy, and perspectives, to construct knowledge, create texts, and demonstrate learning
specific_expectations.text_html: gather, evaluate, and use information, considering validity, credibility, accuracy, and perspectives, to construct knowledge, create texts, and demonstrate learning

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the forms, conventions, and techniques of digital and media texts, consider the impact on the audience, and apply this understanding when analyzing and creating texts
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the forms, conventions, and techniques of digital and media texts, consider the impact on the audience, and apply this understanding when analyzing and creating texts

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the interrelationships between the form, message, and context of texts, the intended audience, and the purpose for production
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the interrelationships between the form, message, and context of texts, the intended audience, and the purpose for production

specific_expectations.text: select and use appropriate digital and media tools to support the design process and address authentic, relevant, real-world problems by developing innovative solutions
specific_expectations.text_html: select and use appropriate digital and media tools to support the design process and address authentic, relevant, real-world problems by developing innovative solutions

specific_expectations.text: communicate and collaborate with various communities in a safe, respectful, responsible, and inclusive manner when using online platforms and environments, including digital and media tools, and demonstrate cultural awareness with members of the community
specific_expectations.text_html: communicate and collaborate with various communities in a safe, respectful, responsible, and inclusive manner when using online platforms and environments, including digital and media tools, and demonstrate cultural awareness with members of the community

overall_expectations.title: Applications, Connections, and Contributions
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 5, in connection with the learning in strands B to D, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply language and literacy skills in cross-curricular and integrated learning, and demonstrate an understanding of, and make connections to, diverse voices, experiences, perspectives, histories, and contributions, including those of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit individuals, communities, groups, and nations
overall_expectations.text_html: apply language and literacy skills in cross-curricular and integrated learning, and demonstrate an understanding of, and make connections to, diverse voices, experiences, perspectives, histories, and contributions, including those of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit individuals, communities, groups, and nations

specific_expectations.text: explain how the knowledge and skills developed in this grade support learning in various subject areas and in everyday life, and describe how they enhance understanding and communication
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how the knowledge and skills developed in this grade support learning in various subject areas and in everyday life, and describe how they enhance understanding and communication

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the historical contexts, contributions, lived experiences, and perspectives of a diversity of individuals and communities, including those in Canada, by exploring the concepts of identity, self, and sense of belonging in a variety of culturally responsive and relevant texts
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the historical contexts, contributions, lived experiences, and perspectives of a diversity of individuals and communities, including those in Canada, by exploring the concepts of identity, self, and sense of belonging in a variety of culturally responsive and relevant texts

specific_expectations.text: explain themes explored in First Nations, Métis, and Inuit cultures to demonstrate an understanding of the varied identities, perspectives, relationships, legacies, truths, and ways of knowing, being, and doing
specific_expectations.text_html: explain themes explored in First Nations, Métis, and Inuit cultures to demonstrate an understanding of the varied identities, perspectives, relationships, legacies, truths, and ways of knowing, being, and doing

strands.title: Foundations of Language
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Oral and Non-Verbal Communication
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply listening, speaking, and non-verbal communication skills and strategies to understand and communicate meaning in formal and informal contexts and for various purposes and audiences
overall_expectations.text_html: apply listening, speaking, and non-verbal communication skills and strategies to understand and communicate meaning in formal and informal contexts and for various purposes and audiences

specific_expectations.text: use effective listening skills, including expressing interest in what is being said at appropriate times, asking questions to encourage a speaker to elaborate, and responding to the contributions of others in group discussions, in formal and informal contexts and for various purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: use effective listening skills, including expressing interest in what is being said at appropriate times, asking questions to encourage a speaker to elaborate, and responding to the contributions of others in group discussions, in formal and informal contexts and for various purposes

specific_expectations.text: select and use a variety of listening strategies before, during, and after listening to comprehend information and messages communicated orally and non-verbally, determine the purpose of a text, construct meaning, seek clarification, and develop an appropriate response
specific_expectations.text_html: select and use a variety of listening strategies before, during, and after listening to comprehend information and messages communicated orally and non-verbally, determine the purpose of a text, construct meaning, seek clarification, and develop an appropriate response

specific_expectations.text: identify the purpose and audience for speaking in formal and informal contexts, and use appropriate speaking strategies, including paraphrasing and restating, to communicate clearly and coherently
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the purpose and audience for speaking in formal and informal contexts, and use appropriate speaking strategies, including paraphrasing and restating, to communicate clearly and coherently

specific_expectations.text: identify and use oral and non-verbal communication strategies, including expression, gestures, and body language, and explain how these strategies help them understand or communicate ideas and meaning
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and use oral and non-verbal communication strategies, including expression, gestures, and body language, and explain how these strategies help them understand or communicate ideas and meaning

specific_expectations.text: use appropriate word choice, including new vocabulary, varied adjectives and adverbs to elaborate, a variety of sentence types, and cohesive sentences during formal and informal communication, to support audience comprehension
specific_expectations.text_html: use appropriate word choice, including new vocabulary, varied adjectives and adverbs to elaborate, a variety of sentence types, and cohesive sentences during formal and informal communication, to support audience comprehension

overall_expectations.title: Language Foundations for Reading and Writing
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of foundational language knowledge and skills, and apply this understanding when reading and writing
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of foundational language knowledge and skills, and apply this understanding when reading and writing

specific_expectations.text: use generalized knowledge of the meanings of words and morphemes (i.e., bases, prefixes, and suffixes) to read and spell words with accuracy and automaticity
specific_expectations.text_html: use generalized knowledge of the meanings of words and morphemes (i.e., bases, prefixes, and suffixes) to read and spell words with accuracy and automaticity

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of a variety of words, acquire and use explicitly taught vocabulary in various contexts, including other subject areas, and use generalized morphological knowledge to analyze and understand new words in context
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of a variety of words, acquire and use explicitly taught vocabulary in various contexts, including other subject areas, and use generalized morphological knowledge to analyze and understand new words in context

specific_expectations.text: read a variety of texts fluently, with accuracy and appropriate pacing to support comprehension, and when reading aloud, adjust expression and intonation according to the purpose of reading
specific_expectations.text_html: read a variety of texts fluently, with accuracy and appropriate pacing to support comprehension, and when reading aloud, adjust expression and intonation according to the purpose of reading

overall_expectations.title: Language Conventions for Reading and Writing
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of sentence structure, grammar, cohesive ties, and capitalization and punctuation, and apply this knowledge when reading and writing sentences, paragraphs, and a variety of texts
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of sentence structure, grammar, cohesive ties, and capitalization and punctuation, and apply this knowledge when reading and writing sentences, paragraphs, and a variety of texts

specific_expectations.text: identify and construct various sentence types and forms, including compound-complex sentences, and correct sentence fragments and run-on sentences
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and construct various sentence types and forms, including compound-complex sentences, and correct sentence fragments and run-on sentences

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the functions of parts of speech in sentences, including direct objects for nouns, intensive and reflexive pronouns, proper adjectives, and correlative conjunctions, and use this knowledge to support comprehension and communicate meaning clearly
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the functions of parts of speech in sentences, including direct objects for nouns, intensive and reflexive pronouns, proper adjectives, and correlative conjunctions, and use this knowledge to support comprehension and communicate meaning clearly

specific_expectations.text: use their understanding of the meaning and function of capitalization and punctuation to communicate meaning clearly and coherently, including the use of commas to set off advanced phrases or clauses, such as appositives and participles, and colons for introducing a list after a complete sentence
specific_expectations.text_html: use their understanding of the meaning and function of capitalization and punctuation to communicate meaning clearly and coherently, including the use of commas to set off advanced phrases or clauses, such as appositives and participles, and colons for introducing a list after a complete sentence

strands.title: Comprehension: Understanding and Responding to Texts
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Knowledge about Texts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply foundational knowledge and skills to understand a variety of texts, including digital and media texts, by creators with diverse identities, perspectives, and experience, and demonstrate an understanding of the patterns, features, and elements of style associated with various text forms and genres
overall_expectations.text_html: apply foundational knowledge and skills to understand a variety of texts, including digital and media texts, by creators with diverse identities, perspectives, and experience, and demonstrate an understanding of the patterns, features, and elements of style associated with various text forms and genres

specific_expectations.text: read and comprehend various texts, using knowledge of words, grammar, cohesive ties, sentence structures, and background knowledge
specific_expectations.text_html: read and comprehend various texts, using knowledge of words, grammar, cohesive ties, sentence structures, and background knowledge

specific_expectations.text: describe some characteristics of various text forms and genres, including cultural text forms, and explain how they help communicate meaning
specific_expectations.text_html: describe some characteristics of various text forms and genres, including cultural text forms, and explain how they help communicate meaning

specific_expectations.text: identify text patterns, such as cause and effect in a persuasive text, and text features, such as a preface and glossary, associated with various text forms, including cultural texts, and explain how they help readers, listeners, and viewers understand the meaning
specific_expectations.text_html: identify text patterns, such as cause and effect in a persuasive text, and text features, such as a preface and glossary, associated with various text forms, including cultural texts, and explain how they help readers, listeners, and viewers understand the meaning

specific_expectations.text: explain how images, graphics, and visual design create, communicate, and contribute to meaning in a variety of texts
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how images, graphics, and visual design create, communicate, and contribute to meaning in a variety of texts

specific_expectations.text: describe various elements of style in texts, including voice, word choice, word patterns, and sentence structure, and analyze how each element helps create meaning and is appropriate for the text form and genre
specific_expectations.text_html: describe various elements of style in texts, including voice, word choice, word patterns, and sentence structure, and analyze how each element helps create meaning and is appropriate for the text form and genre

specific_expectations.text: identify the narrator’s point of view, including first, second, or third person, in a variety of texts, and describe the advantages and disadvantages of the approach used in each story
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the narrator’s point of view, including first, second, or third person, in a variety of texts, and describe the advantages and disadvantages of the approach used in each story

specific_expectations.text: read, listen to, and view various forms of texts by diverse First Nations, Métis, and Inuit creators to make meaning through Indigenous Storywork about First Nations, Métis, and Inuit histories, cultures, relationships, communities, groups, nations, and lived experiences
specific_expectations.text_html: read, listen to, and view various forms of texts by diverse First Nations, Métis, and Inuit creators to make meaning through Indigenous Storywork about First Nations, Métis, and Inuit histories, cultures, relationships, communities, groups, nations, and lived experiences

overall_expectations.title: Comprehension Strategies
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply comprehension strategies before, during, and after reading, listening to, and viewing a variety of texts, including digital and media texts, by creators with diverse identities, perspectives, and experience, in order to understand and clarify the meaning of texts
overall_expectations.text_html: apply comprehension strategies before, during, and after reading, listening to, and viewing a variety of texts, including digital and media texts, by creators with diverse identities, perspectives, and experience, in order to understand and clarify the meaning of texts

specific_expectations.text: identify and explain prior knowledge from various sources, including personal experiences, that they can use to make connections and understand new texts
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and explain prior knowledge from various sources, including personal experiences, that they can use to make connections and understand new texts

specific_expectations.text: identify a variety of purposes for engaging with texts, and select texts from diverse creators that are suitable for the purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: identify a variety of purposes for engaging with texts, and select texts from diverse creators that are suitable for the purposes

specific_expectations.text: make predictions using background knowledge, text features, and evidence from the text, and pose questions to check whether their predictions were correct
specific_expectations.text_html: make predictions using background knowledge, text features, and evidence from the text, and pose questions to check whether their predictions were correct

specific_expectations.text: use strategies such as adjusting reading rate, visualizing, reading ahead, asking questions, and consulting references and other texts or sources of information, to monitor and confirm their understanding of various texts
specific_expectations.text_html: use strategies such as adjusting reading rate, visualizing, reading ahead, asking questions, and consulting references and other texts or sources of information, to monitor and confirm their understanding of various texts

specific_expectations.text: describe how the ideas expressed in texts connect to their knowledges and lived experiences, the ideas in other texts, and the world around them
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how the ideas expressed in texts connect to their knowledges and lived experiences, the ideas in other texts, and the world around them

specific_expectations.text: summarize the main idea of a text and the supporting details in sequence, and draw a well-supported conclusion
specific_expectations.text_html: summarize the main idea of a text and the supporting details in sequence, and draw a well-supported conclusion

specific_expectations.text: explain how strategies such as visualizing, making predictions, summarizing, and connecting to their experiences have helped them comprehend various texts
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how strategies such as visualizing, making predictions, summarizing, and connecting to their experiences have helped them comprehend various texts

overall_expectations.title: Critical Thinking in Literacy
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply critical thinking skills to deepen understanding of texts, and analyze how various perspectives and topics are communicated and addressed in a variety of texts, including digital, media, and cultural texts
overall_expectations.text_html: apply critical thinking skills to deepen understanding of texts, and analyze how various perspectives and topics are communicated and addressed in a variety of texts, including digital, media, and cultural texts

specific_expectations.text: describe literary devices, including imagery and humour, in a variety of texts, and explain how they help create meaning and are appropriate for the intended purpose and audience
specific_expectations.text_html: describe literary devices, including imagery and humour, in a variety of texts, and explain how they help create meaning and are appropriate for the intended purpose and audience

specific_expectations.text: make local and global inferences, using explicit and implicit evidence, to extend their understanding of various texts
specific_expectations.text_html: make local and global inferences, using explicit and implicit evidence, to extend their understanding of various texts

specific_expectations.text: analyze various texts, including literary and informational texts, by identifying main and supporting ideas, sequencing the events of multiple plots, recording relevant information, and explaining cause and effect
specific_expectations.text_html: analyze various texts, including literary and informational texts, by identifying main and supporting ideas, sequencing the events of multiple plots, recording relevant information, and explaining cause and effect

specific_expectations.text: identify cultural elements that are represented in various texts, including, norms, values, artifacts, sports, and music, investigate the meanings of these elements, and make connections to their lived experience and culture
specific_expectations.text_html: identify cultural elements that are represented in various texts, including, norms, values, artifacts, sports, and music, investigate the meanings of these elements, and make connections to their lived experience and culture

specific_expectations.text: identify explicit and implicit perspectives communicated in various texts, explain how these perspectives are conveyed, give some evidence of any biases the texts may contain, and suggest how such biases could influence an audience
specific_expectations.text_html: identify explicit and implicit perspectives communicated in various texts, explain how these perspectives are conveyed, give some evidence of any biases the texts may contain, and suggest how such biases could influence an audience

specific_expectations.text: explain how various topics, such as diversity, inclusion, and accessibility, are addressed in texts, and describe what insights or messages are conveyed
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how various topics, such as diversity, inclusion, and accessibility, are addressed in texts, and describe what insights or messages are conveyed

specific_expectations.text: explain how texts created by First Nations, Métis, and Inuit individuals, communities, groups, or nations are influenced by historical periods, cultural experiences, and events, and how they relate to current lived experiences
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how texts created by First Nations, Métis, and Inuit individuals, communities, groups, or nations are influenced by historical periods, cultural experiences, and events, and how they relate to current lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: identify the critical thinking skills they used to analyze and evaluate various texts, and explain how these skills have helped them better understand the texts
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the critical thinking skills they used to analyze and evaluate various texts, and explain how these skills have helped them better understand the texts

strands.title: Composition: Expressing Ideas and Creating Texts
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Developing Ideas and Organizing Content
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: plan, develop ideas, gather information, and organize content for creating texts of various forms, including digital and media texts, on a variety of topics
overall_expectations.text_html: plan, develop ideas, gather information, and organize content for creating texts of various forms, including digital and media texts, on a variety of topics

specific_expectations.text: identify the topic, purpose, and audience for various texts they plan to create, and explain why the chosen text form, genre, and medium suit the purpose and audience and how they will help communicate the intended meaning
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the topic, purpose, and audience for various texts they plan to create, and explain why the chosen text form, genre, and medium suit the purpose and audience and how they will help communicate the intended meaning

specific_expectations.text: generate and develop ideas and details about various topics, such as topics related to diversity, equity, and inclusion and to other subject areas, using a variety of strategies, and drawing on various resources, including their own lived experiences
specific_expectations.text_html: generate and develop ideas and details about various topics, such as topics related to diversity, equity, and inclusion and to other subject areas, using a variety of strategies, and drawing on various resources, including their own lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: gather and record information and content relevant to a topic, using multiple textual sources; verify the reliability of sources, using simple criteria; and record the creator and source of all content created by others
specific_expectations.text_html: gather and record information and content relevant to a topic, using multiple textual sources; verify the reliability of sources, using simple criteria; and record the creator and source of all content created by others

specific_expectations.text: select and classify ideas and collected information, using appropriate strategies and tools, and sequence content, taking into account the chosen text form, genre, and medium
specific_expectations.text_html: select and classify ideas and collected information, using appropriate strategies and tools, and sequence content, taking into account the chosen text form, genre, and medium

specific_expectations.text: describe the strategies and tools that helped them develop ideas and organize content for texts of the chosen forms, genres, and media, and explain how they helped them improve as a text creator
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the strategies and tools that helped them develop ideas and organize content for texts of the chosen forms, genres, and media, and explain how they helped them improve as a text creator

overall_expectations.title: Creating Texts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: apply knowledge and understanding of various text forms and genres to create, revise, edit, and proofread their own texts, using a variety of media, tools, and strategies, and reflect critically on created texts
overall_expectations.text_html: apply knowledge and understanding of various text forms and genres to create, revise, edit, and proofread their own texts, using a variety of media, tools, and strategies, and reflect critically on created texts

specific_expectations.text: draft texts of various forms and genres, including narrative, persuasive, and informational texts, using a variety of media, tools, and strategies
specific_expectations.text_html: draft texts of various forms and genres, including narrative, persuasive, and informational texts, using a variety of media, tools, and strategies

specific_expectations.text: write in fluent cursive, begin to keyboard with automaticity, and apply word-processing skills, including selecting appropriate fonts, to produce and enhance texts of various lengths
specific_expectations.text_html: write in fluent cursive, begin to keyboard with automaticity, and apply word-processing skills, including selecting appropriate fonts, to produce and enhance texts of various lengths

specific_expectations.text: establish a personal voice in their texts, using varied language and elements of style to express their thoughts, feelings, and opinions about a topic, and using a tone appropriate to the form and genre
specific_expectations.text_html: establish a personal voice in their texts, using varied language and elements of style to express their thoughts, feelings, and opinions about a topic, and using a tone appropriate to the form and genre

specific_expectations.text: identify the point of view, implicit and explicit perspectives, and bias conveyed in their texts, and explain how their messages might be interpreted by audiences with different perspectives
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the point of view, implicit and explicit perspectives, and bias conveyed in their texts, and explain how their messages might be interpreted by audiences with different perspectives

specific_expectations.text: make revisions to the content of draft texts and to elements of style, such as word choice, and add or delete sentences, to improve clarity, focus, and coherence, seeking feedback
specific_expectations.text_html: make revisions to the content of draft texts and to elements of style, such as word choice, and add or delete sentences, to improve clarity, focus, and coherence, seeking feedback

specific_expectations.text: edit draft texts to improve accuracy and style, checking for errors in spelling, punctuation, grammar, and format; use a word processor to edit texts
specific_expectations.text_html: edit draft texts to improve accuracy and style, checking for errors in spelling, punctuation, grammar, and format; use a word processor to edit texts

overall_expectations.title: Publishing, Presenting, and Reflecting
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: select suitable and effective media, techniques, and tools to publish and present final texts, and critically analyze how well the texts address various topics
overall_expectations.text_html: select suitable and effective media, techniques, and tools to publish and present final texts, and critically analyze how well the texts address various topics

specific_expectations.text: produce final texts using a variety of techniques and tools, including digital design and production tools, to achieve the intended effect
specific_expectations.text_html: produce final texts using a variety of techniques and tools, including digital design and production tools, to achieve the intended effect

specific_expectations.text: publish and present texts they have created, using selected media and tools, and explain how each helped them communicate their intended message
specific_expectations.text_html: publish and present texts they have created, using selected media and tools, and explain how each helped them communicate their intended message

specific_expectations.text: describe various strategies and tools that helped them communicate their intended message when publishing and presenting texts, and suggest steps for future improvement as a text creator
specific_expectations.text_html: describe various strategies and tools that helped them communicate their intended message when publishing and presenting texts, and suggest steps for future improvement as a text creator
